text: And through the throngs of the myriads of Thy people the House of Israel is Thy Name, O our King, glorified with joy in every generation. For thus it is the duty of all creatures before Thee, O Lord our God and God of our fathers, to thank, to extol, to praise, to glorify, to exalt, to honour, to bless, to elevate and to sing praises with all the words of the songs and eulogies of David the son of Jesse, Thy servant, Thine anointed.
